children: Samsara reported second quarter fiscal 2027 results with total revenue of $508.4 million, up 30% year‑over‑year, and ending annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $2.125 billion, a 30% increase versus the prior year. The company recorded GAAP net income of $16.2 million and GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.03, marking its fourth consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability. Non‑GAAP diluted EPS was $0.20 for the quarter.
Total revenue: $508.4 million for Q2 FY2027 (30% year‑over‑year growth).
Annual recurring revenue (ARR): $2,124.7 million at quarter end (30% year‑over‑year growth).
GAAP gross profit: $392.6 million; GAAP gross margin: 77%.
GAAP income from operations: $4.9 million; GAAP net income per share, basic and diluted: $0.03.
Non‑GAAP metrics: Non‑GAAP gross profit $398.0 million (78% margin); Non‑GAAP operating income $106.0 million; Non‑GAAP net income per share, diluted: $0.20.
Net new ARR for the quarter: $134.1 million, representing 28% year‑over‑year growth (actual and constant currency).
Large customers (those with ARR over $1,000,000) generated over $500 million of ARR, more than 50% year‑over‑year growth for the third consecutive quarter.
Customer adoption of recent AI features increased more than 4x over the prior two months, signaling accelerated product engagement.
Cash generation remained strong: net cash provided by operating activities was $73.5 million and free cash flow was $64.7 million for the quarter.
Company reaffirmed ongoing product innovation and platform momentum, highlighting continued focus on Connected Operations platform expansion and AI capability rollout.
